# Artifisio illustrations registry

> Free, open-licensed illustrations (CC-BY-4.0) as plain files plus a versioned manifest. Install with the `artifisio` CLI or fetch files straight from the CDN. No account, no runtime dependency.

- Manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/artifisio/illustrations/main/manifest.json (schemaVersion 2, registryVersion 2026.09.14-0939-104a9e3)
- Registry index across kinds: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/artifisio/illustrations/main/index.json
- CDN file pattern: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/artifisio/illustrations@main/sets/<set>/<file>
- Install: `npx artifisio add <set>` (writes files + ATTRIBUTION.md)
- Search: `npx artifisio search "<query>" --kind illustration --json`
- License: LICENSE in this repo; attribution string is in every set's `license.attribution`.

## Sets (21)

- [Zenithglade](https://github.com/artifisio/illustrations/tree/main/sets/zenithglade): Bring a sense of profound stillness to your next project by blending the wonders of the future with the timeless art of inner peace. These illustrations are your gateway to creating a digital sanctuary that resonates with anyone looking to find their center in a fast-paced world. You will give your brand a soul that feels both cutting-edge and deeply restorative. (32 illustrations)
- [Orbitab](https://github.com/artifisio/illustrations/tree/main/sets/orbitab): Elevate your daily planning with a cosmic touch that turns every mundane task into an interstellar adventure. These charming space-themed stationery pieces bring a sense of wonder to your digital notebooks, helping you stay inspired as you navigate your galaxy of ideas. (33 illustrations)
- [Fernforge](https://github.com/artifisio/illustrations/tree/main/sets/fernforge): Transform your designs with a serene vision of technology and nature working in perfect, nurturing harmony as mechanical arms tend to delicate succulents. You will find endless inspiration in these gentle guardians that bring a sense of quiet wonder and modern tranquility to your digital or physical spaces. This collection is the perfect choice for infusing your branding or decor with a unique atmosphere of care and futuristic peace. (25 illustrations)
